periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, approximately 45-degree angle oriented downwards towards the medial snout line.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward elongation towards the malar region, creating a teardrop-like taper.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 35% of the visible vertical torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance is approximately equal to the horizontal width of the cranial crown between the ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-rufous staining of the ventral/abdominal fur compared to the bright white fur of the head.
